- Total revenue reached £63,322.09 TW, up 6.9% WoW from £59,216.04 LW and up 65.9% YoY.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT generated the highest revenue at £2,152.90 TW with a 3.4% share, increasing 40.6% WoW.
- WOOD BLACK BOARD ANT WHITE FINISH achieved the second highest revenue of £2,057.46 TW with a 3.2% share, surging 496.6% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked third with £1,991.04 TW revenue and a 3.1% share, declining 31.5% WoW.
- SMALL ZINC HEART WALL ORGANISER experienced the largest WoW increase at 11787.1%, rising from £11.50 LW to £1,367.02 TW.
- ALARM CLOCK BAKELIKE RED recorded the largest WoW decrease at -80.7%, falling from £1,667.45 LW to £322.54 TW.
- FELTCRAFT PRINCESS OLIVIA DOLL showed the largest YoY increase at 23496.0%, growing from £3.75 LY to current week revenue.
- JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT generated the most orders with 44 TW compared to 43 LW.
